ItemID: NA; Title: OVERTURE PETG Filament 1.75mm, 3D Printer Filament, 6kg Spool (13.2lbs), Dimensional Accuracy 99% Probability +/- 0.03 mm, Fit Most FDM Printer (6 Color (6-Pack)); ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: My recent projects involve tools and fasteners; I have no current need for 3D printer filament.
ItemID: NA; Title: TIANSE PLA Filament 1.75mm PLA 3D Printer Filament, 5kg Cardboard Spool (11 lbs), Dimensional Accuracy +/- 0.03mm (Black 1-Pack); ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: A bulk filament spool does not support any printing project I currently have planned.
ItemID: NA; Title: 100 Nitrile Exam Gloves 3.5 Mil - Latex & Powder Free, Disposable Non-Sterile Protective Gloves By PlastCare; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Disposable gloves could help with messy workshop tasks, but I would check chemical compatibility before choosing them for resin work.
ItemID: NA; Title: 5/16 x 5-1/2" (8 pcs) Hex Lag Screws, 304 Stainless Steel 18/8, Hexagon Head Lag Bolts, Hex Head Wood Screws; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: These large lag screws are too specific without a current heavy timber fastening project.
ItemID: NA; Title: #4 x 5/8" Pan Head Phillps Drive Self Tapping Screws, 304 Stainless Steel, Cross Recessed Pan Head Wood Screws, Sheet Metal Tek Screws, 100 PCS; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: Small stainless self tapping screws would be useful for the repair and assembly work reflected in my recent purchases.
ItemID: NA; Title: Realth Magnets Disc Neodymium 0.79” x 0.08” 10 Pack Round Permanent Rare Earth Magnetic for Fridge Office Science Project Craft(MC20210); ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I do not currently have a project that needs disc magnets.
ItemID: NA; Title: toolant Four Spiral Flute Step Drill Bit Set (Pro), 1/8"-7/8"(3pcs) Impact Ready Advanced High Speed Steel Unibit Step Bit, 1/4" Hex Shank Unibit for Metal, Stainless Steel, Aluminum, Wood, Plastic; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 5; REASON: Step bits would complement my existing drill set for making different hole sizes in sheet metal for rivets and hardware.
ItemID: NA; Title: Matework Step Drill Bit for Metal, Four Spiral Flute Cobalt Step Drill Bit (1/4"-3/4") Wear-Resistant TiAlN Coated, 1/4" Hex Shank Unibit for Carbon Steel, Stainless Steel, Wood, Plastic (M35 9 Size); ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: This fits my metalworking needs, but I would choose the broader toolant set this time rather than buy overlapping bits.
ItemID: NA; Title: 1/4-20 x 3/4" (30 pcs) Truss Head Machine Screws, 304 Stainless Steel (18-8), Cross Recessed Truss Head Machine Screws, Phillips Drive, Coarse Thread UNC, ANSI B18.6.3T; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: These could pair with the 1/4-20 rivet nuts in my recent assortment, provided the length suits the assembly.
